message.content:
It sounds like you’re thinking of really scorching heat! In reality, **Boston’s summer temperatures rarely reach anywhere near 54 °C**—that would be hotter than most deserts on Earth. Here’s what typically happens:

| Season | Typical Highs | Typical Lows |
|--------|---------------|--------------|
| Summer (June–August) | ~28–32 °C (82–90 °F) | ~17–20 °C (63–68 °F) |
| Fall (Sept–Nov) | ~15–22 °C (59–72 °F) | ~7–12 °C (45–53 °F) |

During July‑August, daytime highs often hover between **80–85 °F (27–29 °C)**, occasionally peaking into the low 90s (≈33 °C), especially after a warm spell from the Gulf Stream. Even then, it’s far below the extreme 54 °C mark.

If you’re planning a trip or looking at recent weather trends, let me know—I can pull up today’s actual forecast for Boston so you have the latest numbers!
